why: The locator also matched list items of the product grid behind the cart panel.
The Agregar button showed a spinner while the cart was validated server-side, and the assertion timeout was too short.
The results list was re-rendered during hydration and the first card was a non-grocery product that is added without asking for a location.
The site blocks the Confirmar button only with CSS pointer-events, and the test tried to click it.
Disabled react-select inputs are excluded from role-based queries, so the locator never matches.
A whole-run 60 s timeout whose cause was never diagnosed.
Cloudflare blocked the request, observed during manual testing of the same site.
